title: lathyrus californicus
intro: Lathyrus californicus, commonly known as California peavine or California vetchling, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus californicus include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
